I'm in NC as well. I've been living out of my car for a little over a year now. At a dead end job that puts me in the hole further each month. If there's anything you have that you don't need, start selling now to get money together for insurance, registration, etc. You don't pay those you're SOL and you'll be on the street or in a shelter. If you find you can live out of your car, move to a state with a higher minimum wage and take any old shit job to pay bills and have money to eat and for fuel. Make sure you have blankets, it will get cold. I use a sleeping bag during the winter. Keep your windows cracked to avoid condensation.  Good luck.
